title: Project Management Source Gate: off-discipline readings stop entering trusted proof

claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.75 Project Management ZIP/log audit that regraded at 97/A and stays honest that the package is not yet a clean 100/100.

Project Management now has an explicit discipline inference and OpenAlex topic allowlist, so medical projection papers are rejected while project-management business/decision-science rows remain eligible.
Course-map readiness now treats generated fallback stems as weak topic candidates, preventing repair sentences from being reused as the next repaired topic.
The language finalizer collapses exact X:X echoes and course-map topic cleanup strips terminal punctuation before templating, closing the reproduced double-period and repeated-label defects.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify score, texture, enrichment coverage, source relevance, package card state, and export UI truth.
Continue improving recovery so every requested lesson enriches before export whenever provider output allows it.
Generalize source relevance checks beyond Project Management so trusted rows are both source-valid and course-relevant.
Simplify export-panel warnings into a clean downloadable state with compact review detail instead of exposing every internal warning.
